list.title: Suppliers
list.introFull: Your organization's supplier register. Search by name, tax ID or supplier code, and see which suppliers still have no Express vendor code, which the export file needs
list.introBasic: The suppliers in your organization's register. Use it to look up names and codes when you suggest a supplier in a request

filter.searchHintFull: Name, tax ID (with or without dashes) or supplier code
filter.searchHintMasked: Name, tax ID (with or without dashes) or supplier code. An individual's tax ID is found only when all 13 digits are typed
filter.missingExpress: Only those without an Express vendor code
filter.limited: Showing the first {shown}. Search by name or code to find the others
filter.searchHintItems: You can also search by an item bought before, such as cement.
filter.label: Supplier filters

list.emptyNone: There are no suppliers in the register yet
list.emptyNoneManage: Add the first supplier with its 13-digit tax ID. The name and address are filled in from the Revenue Department and DBD
list.emptyNoneOther: Contact procurement to add suppliers to the register
list.emptyNoMatchHint: Try a shorter search, or clear the filters to see all suppliers
list.forbiddenTitle: You cannot view the supplier register
list.forbidden: This account cannot view the supplier register. Contact your organization's administrator

check.MANUAL: Confirmed by a person with proof
check.FOREIGN: Foreign supplier: no Thai registry check

detail.created: Supplier saved. It can be used in requests and the purchasing queue right away
detail.taxIdMaskedNote: Partly hidden because it is an individual's national ID number
detail.expressMissingOther: None yet. The Express export leaves out this supplier's invoices. Ask procurement to add the code
detail.expressMissingManage: This supplier has no Express vendor code yet. The export leaves out its invoices until the code is added. Add it under Vendor code and contacts below
detail.basicNote: You see the supplier's name and basic details. Other details are for procurement, finance and auditors
detail.juristicIndividual: Not checked: individuals are not in the DBD registry
detail.registryVat: VAT status at the Revenue Department
detail.stubNote: This check comes from the simulated registry used on test machines and in the demo. The real Revenue Department and DBD services were not called
detail.proofNotOpened: The file could not be opened, or you may not open it. Try again
detail.proofHidden: An individual's proof shows their national ID number, so only procurement and finance can open it

edit.detailsHint: The tax ID and branch cannot be changed because they were checked against the registries. If they are wrong, stop using this supplier and add it again
edit.codesHint: The Express vendor code goes into the export file for accounting. The e-mail address receives purchase orders
edit.activeHint: This supplier is in use: requesters may suggest it and procurement may choose it in the purchasing queue
edit.inactiveHint: This supplier is no longer used: requesters cannot suggest it and procurement cannot choose it. You can use it again at any time
edit.deactivateDetail: Once stopped, requesters cannot suggest this supplier in new requests, procurement cannot choose it in the purchasing queue, and its draft purchase orders cannot be sent for approval. Purchase orders already issued do not change. You can use it again later

fields.nameThHint: The name used on purchase orders
fields.addressHint: The address used on purchase orders
fields.vatForeignHint: Most foreign suppliers are not VAT registered in Thailand
fields.categoryHint: What the supplier sells, e.g. building materials, IT
fields.codeHint: The code used in the system: letters, digits, - or _. The next code is suggested; you may change it
fields.expressHint: The supplier's code in Express. The export file needs it; you may add it later
fields.emailHint: Purchase orders are sent to this address
fields.missingVat: Choose whether the supplier is VAT registered
fields.badCode: Use only letters, digits, - and _ (40 characters at most)
fields.badEmail: This e-mail address is not valid, e.g. sales@example.com

new.title: Add a supplier
new.intro: Type the 13-digit tax ID. The Revenue Department and DBD fill in the rest for you to check before saving
new.forbidden: Only procurement adds suppliers. If you need a new supplier, send a new-supplier request from the Buy or hire page
new.stubMode: Test mode: registry data comes from a simulated registry. The real Revenue Department and DBD services are not called
new.kindThai: A supplier in Thailand with a 13-digit tax ID
new.kindForeign: A foreign supplier without a Thai tax ID
new.foreignNote: Foreign suppliers are not checked against Thai registries. Enter the supplier's details in the next step
new.taxIdHint: 13 digits, with or without dashes or spaces
new.taxIdChecksum: This number is not valid: the last digit does not match the check digit. Check the number again
new.taxIdJuristic: Valid: a juristic person, checked with the Revenue Department and DBD
new.taxIdIndividual: Valid: an individual, checked with the Revenue Department only because DBD has no individuals
new.lookup: Look up at the Revenue Department and DBD

result.title: Registry result
result.none: Not looked up yet. Enter the tax ID and branch, then look it up
result.found: Found in the registry. The name, address and VAT status are filled in on the next step; check and change them before saving
result.name: Name
result.sourceStub: Simulated registry (stub mode): the real services were not called
result.vatUnknown: No data at the Revenue Department
result.juristicIndividual: Not checked: individuals are not in the DBD registry
result.notFound: This number is not in the Revenue Department or DBD registry. Check the number, or confirm the supplier yourself with a company certificate or VAT certificate (ภ.พ.20)
result.unavailable: The Revenue Department or DBD service is not answering now. Look it up again later, or confirm the supplier yourself with a company certificate or VAT certificate (ภ.พ.20)
result.individualRdOnly: Individuals can be checked with the Revenue Department only, because DBD has juristic persons only
result.existing: A supplier with this tax ID and branch is already in the register: {code} {name}. Use that supplier, or change the branch code if this is another branch

proof.title: Confirm yourself with proof
proof.intro: Attach a company certificate or VAT certificate (ภ.พ.20) that shows this tax ID. The register records that you confirmed this supplier with this file
proof.upload: Attach proof: certificate or ภ.พ.20

needs.taxId: Enter a valid 13-digit tax ID first
needs.lookup: Look it up at the Revenue Department and DBD before the next step
needs.stale: The tax ID or branch changed after the lookup. Look it up again
needs.existing: This supplier is already in the register. Change the number or branch to go on
needs.proof: The registries could not confirm this supplier. Attach proof before the next step

new.filledFromRegistry: The name, address and VAT status come from the registry. Check and change them; the registry's values are kept to compare

summary.title: Check before saving
summary.name: Supplier name
summary.methodLookup: Checked against the registries; checked again when you save
summary.methodMissing: Not checked yet. Go back to the identity step

new.saveAfter: When you save, the registries are checked again and their values are kept to compare. The supplier can be used in requests and the purchasing queue right away
new.saveAfterForeign: When you save, the supplier can be used in requests and the purchasing queue right away

errors.TAX_ID_INVALID: The tax ID is not valid. Check the 13 digits again
errors.BRANCH: The branch code must be 5 digits, e.g. 00000
errors.SUPPLIER_EXISTS: A supplier with this tax ID and branch is already in the register (code {code}). Use that supplier or change the branch code
errors.CODE_EXISTS: Another supplier already has this code. Change the code and save again
errors.CODE: Supplier codes use letters, digits, - and _ only (40 characters at most)
errors.NAME: Enter the supplier's name
errors.EMAIL: The e-mail address is not valid, e.g. sales@example.com
errors.REGISTRY_CHECK_REQUIRED: Look the supplier up in the registries first, or confirm it yourself with proof
errors.REGISTRY_PROOF_REQUIRED: When saving, the registries were checked again and could not confirm this supplier. Attach a company certificate or ภ.พ.20 and save again
errors.FILE: Only a file you uploaded yourself and that passed the checks can be attached. Upload the proof again
errors.NO_CHANGE: Nothing has changed yet. Edit something before saving
errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone changed this supplier after you opened this page. Load the latest details and edit again
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only procurement adds or edits suppliers
errors.NOT_FOUND: This supplier was not found. Reload the page and try again
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again and try once more
errors.SERVICE: The registry lookup is not available right now. Confirm the supplier yourself with proof, or contact the platform administrator
errors.INPUT: Some fields are not valid. Check the fields with a warning and try again
errors.BUSY: The system is busy with another action. Try again in a moment
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong in the system. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your administrator the reference {requestId}
errors.FAILED: It did not work. Try again

prices.label: Latest prices
prices.intro: Latest prices are the unit prices before VAT on the last approved PO of each item.
